text_block_list.text: On the way back from a walk, I heard lively voices. Wondering what it was, I headed toward the sound and found K.S.Miracle and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet, not yet...! 
Heheh... There's nooo way Turbo is gonna... 
g-get caught...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tired-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Let's just stop already~...
Why do you have to go all out
for a simple game of tag anyway~...?

text_block_list.name: Slumped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Geez, Turbo.
We have training tomorrow too, you know.
Are you trying to burn through all your stamina?

"For something she claims was 'nothing,'
Twin Turbo is sweating as if she just finished a race."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
...Ahaha, surprised you, didn't she?
Turbo's always like that.

"From what they said, Twin Turbo and the others
had already been playing tag here
for quite a while."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: At first, I was just casually watching as I passed by. But then, Miracle called out and asked me to play with them too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, over here, over here...!
I-I knew it, nobody can... catch up to... Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ooooryaaaaah...!
*gasp*... *wheeze*...
The surrounding Umamusume have given up and shifted into watching over Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've been caught so many times already.
And yet, I keep telling myself 'just one more time, just one more time.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Everyone stops running before they reach their limit, and yet...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Her front-running is so straightforward, isn't it?
Without any turbidity or complexity,
it's purely honest all the way through...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I kind of admire that.

That was K.S. Miracle's assessment of Twin Turbo's
running style. But if you asked me, she too was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... M-Miracle, are you...
giving up... too...!?
B-But we've barely even started running...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Did you chicken out before Turbo's speed...!? Hehehe... Turbo really is the strongest...
*gasp* *wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Turbo...! You should take a break soon!
choice_data_list: So Miracle didn't chase after them?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... even though you were that tired,
for a newcomer like me to try and chase after you...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That just doesn't feel fair at all...

Muttering that she's happy to be invited out to play,
K.S. Miracle looks at Twin Turbo with a troubled expression.
choice_data_list: Then should we just keep watching over them?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, but...
choice_data_list: Twin Turbo's itching for a showdown

text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she gets caught, no matter the situation,
she never stops running like that.
Twin Turbo wants to compete 'right now.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...'Now'...
...I see. Turbo is always
giving her all to the 'now'...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I will too...!
—I'll go catch them!

Twin Turbo was caught easily.
Her cries of frustration echoed around the area,
but a smile quickly returned to her face—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was fun! Miracle, you did great!!
But Turbo's gonna win next time,
so you better be ready!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Ahaha. You really are amazing, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. But Miracle is amazing too!!
You caught Turbo, and I've seen
you running in races before!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Umm, it's swooosh and then WOOOAAAH! Always keeping your eyes on the goal!! Full power!! Just like Turbo!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Together with you?
choice_data_list: That was a straight, unwavering run.
That was a straight, unwavering run, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
Oh boy, you got me.

As if realizing something,
K.S.Miracle gave
an embarrassed smile.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...No. If we leave it like that,
it really seems like they might collapse.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel a bit bad about this, but...
I'm going to go catch them!

Twin Turbo was easily caught.
Even so, she didn't seem ready to give up—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I lost! So frustrating, so frustrating!!
One more time! Miracle, one more time!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's save it for next time. Besides,
Turbo just ran a ton, so it doesn't count as a win or loss.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A match is a match, though!! A loss is a loss!
I'm so frustrated! Since I'm frustrated, let's play again!
Next time, Turbo's deeeefinitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Turbo.
Don't push yourself too hard, okay—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna keep running until I win! Even if Turbo wins, I'll keep running anyway!! 'Cause Turbo wants to keep winning forever!

She won't stop running until she achieves her goal.
That figure of hers is just like—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...

When I offered a bright smile,
KS Miracle gave a wry smile
and scratched her head.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not pushing myself too hard,
but I need to make sure I don't collapse.
